rows.quote: The BC datasets from three large-scale studies, ieu-b-4874, ukb-b-8193, and FinnGen_R11_C3_BLADDER_EXALL, were used as the outcome variables, respectively.
rows.coder_note: Rule B: ieu-b-4874 is an OpenGWAS accession (1279 cases, 372,016 controls per the other passage) that no dictionary row lists; the MRC-IEU row covers ukb-b and ukb-d identifiers only.

rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote: Of these, the ieu-b-4874 dataset has 1279 BC patients and 372,016 normal controls of European ancestry; the ukb-b-8193 data from the UKBB [28] database, stored in the openGWAS database, has 1101 cancer cases and 461,832 normal controls of European ancestry; FinnGen_ R11_C3_BLADDER_EXALL dataset contains 2574 cases and 345,118 controls of European ancestry [27].
rows.coder_note: The OpenGWAS accession ukb-b-8193 (UKBB data stored in openGWAS, European, 1101 + 461,832 = 462,933, within the row's 463,005) is a ukb-b identifier of the MRC-IEU pipeline row. For adjudication: the results passage and Table 1 label the same third dataset ukb-d-C67; ukb-d is an alias of the same dictionary row, so no other row is identified.
